products.name: LMSYS Arena Models
products.note: Model evaluation platform; crowdsourced benchmarking; research transparency; no production use

profile_text.body:
LMSYS is a nonprofit organization that operates Lmarena.ai, a platform it describes as an official AI ranking and LLM leaderboard. The site invites users to chat with, compare, and vote on AI models across text, image, and code categories, with the stated aim of building a crowdsourced, community-driven public leaderboard through real-world evaluation. The site notes that user conversations and certain other personal information may be disclosed to relevant AI providers and may also be made publicly available to support the community and advance AI research.

The organization's tracked product, listed under the Chat and General LLMs category, is LMSYS Arena Models, characterized as a model evaluation platform focused on crowdsourced benchmarking and research transparency rather than production use. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are held for LMSYS.
